item.title: Nikki Haley urges Trump to make Iran action a 'legacy-defining moment' before leaving office
item.description: Former U.S. Ambassador to the U.N. Nikki Haley said Iran has "never been weaker" and urged President Donald Trump to finish the job before leaving office on "Special Report."

item.title: JFK’s grandson Jack Schlossberg doubles down on attacks against RFK Jr, warns of 'dangerous' agenda
item.description: JFK's grandson Jack Schlossberg called his cousin RFK Jr., the Secretary of Health and Human Services, "dangerous" and criticized his vaccine policies.

item.title: Record-setting wave of mountain deaths rocks Italy after avalanches strike
item.description: At least a dozen people died in Italian backcountry avalanches after the Winter Olympics began. Officials cited unstable snow and backcountry conditions.

item.title: Eileen Gu garners backlash for commenting on Trump's statement while representing China
item.description: Eileen Gu faces social media backlash after criticizing President Donald Trump while remaining silent on China's alleged human rights abuses. Enes Kanter Freedom calls her a "traitor."

item.title: Key House committee advances nationwide voter ID bill, setting up 2026 election fight
item.description: The SAVE America Act would mandate voter photo ID nationwide and expand citizenship checks as Republicans pressure the Senate to take up the election integrity bill.

item.title: LeBron James ends historic 21-year streak after missing too many games this season
item.description: LeBron James' historic 21-year All-NBA streak will end, as the Lakers star will miss too many games this season due to injuries and load management decisions.

item.title: American Ashley Farquharson captures rare Olympic luge medal at Winter Games
item.description: The first U.S. women's luge medal since 2014 went to Ashley Farquharson, who overcame fifth-place start to earn Olympic bronze in thrilling competition.

item.title: Grand jury rejects DOJ effort to indict Democratic lawmakers who urged military to defy illegal orders
item.description: A grand jury refused to indict Democratic lawmakers who urged military members to ignore "illegal orders," dealing a blow to the Justice Department.

item.title: FDA refuses to review Moderna’s mRNA flu vaccine application
item.description: FDA refuses Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine application, citing inadequate study design, as the company disputes decision, saying it contradicts prior FDA guidance.
